top_signals.title: Boeing adds to big week with first full-rate Grey Wolf helicopter order
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Air Force awarded Boeing a roughly $85 million contract for four more MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopters, with the first under full-rate production.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: NEAR Intents recovers entire stolen $3.8M after ultimatum to exploiter
top_signals.summary: The exploiter returned the entire sum to NEAR Intents after being identified and given 48 hours to respond.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
